hf:timm/mobilenetv3_small_100.lamb_in1k.summary_en: MobileNetV3-Small 100 is a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for mobile and edge devices. It uses inverted residual blocks with linear bottlenecks and squeeze-and-excitation modules for efficient computation. The model was trained on ImageNet-1k dataset using LAMB optimizer and achieves competitive accuracy while maintaining low computational requirements. This implementation is available in PyTorch format with safetensors.

hf:sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v.summary_en: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a sentence embedding model that converts text into dense vector representations. hf:google-bert/bert-base-uncased.summary_en: BERT-Base Uncased is a foundational transformer model for natural language processing tasks. hf:google/electra-base-discriminator.summary_en: Google ELECTRA-base-discriminator is a pre-trained language model using the ELECTRA framework. It employs a replaced token detection pre-training method where a generator replaces tokens and a discriminator identifies replacements. The model supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it provides base discriminator weights for natural language understanding tasks and transformer-based processing.

hf:openai/clip-vit-base-patch32.summary_en: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a vision-language model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text. It uses a Vision Transformer architecture with patch size 32 and is trained on 400 million image-text pairs. The model enables zero-shot image classification by comparing image features with text descriptions. It supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, and is compatible with Transformers library. Based on research from papers arXiv:1908.04913 and arXiv:2103.00020.

hf:FacebookAI/roberta-large.summary_en: RoBERTa-Large is a large-scale language model developed by Facebook AI, optimized from BERT architecture. hf:sentence-transformers/paraphrase-mult.summary_en: This multilingual sentence embedding model generates semantic representations for text in over 50 languages.
